book.cc_aeroworks.page_1:
CC-Aeroworks API

Find a Control Desk:

local desk = peripheral.find("cc_aeroworks_control_desk")

assert(desk, "No desk found")
book.cc_aeroworks.page_2:
Inspect the desk

getSockets()
getModules()
getModule(socket)
getInputs()
getInput(socket)
getDisplays()
getDisplay(socket)

Sockets: left=0, right=1, big=2. Names and indices are valid.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_3:
Input event

local e, name, socket, id, value = os.pullEvent("cc_aeroworks_desk_input")

The event is emitted only when a value changes.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_4:
Display text

setDisplayText(socket, text)
setDisplayNumber(socket, value, zeroPad)
clearDisplay(socket)
clearDisplays()

Two digit: 2 chars
Three digit: 3 chars
book.cc_aeroworks.page_5:
Display pixels

getDisplaySize(socket)
getDisplayPixel(socket,x,y)
setDisplayPixel(socket,x,y,on)
setDisplayPixels(socket,rows)
clearDisplayPixels(socket)

Coordinates start at 1,1.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_6:
Pixel grids

Two digit: 7x5
Three digit: 11x5

rows is a table of exactly 5 strings. Each string contains only 0 and 1 and exactly matches the display width.
book.cc_aeroworks.page_8:
Combined control

Select Combined and capture the activation key in the centre field.

Lever/Throttle: Mouse Y
Joystick left/right: Mouse X
Joystick forward/back: Mouse Y
guide.cc_aeroworks.title: CC-Aeroworks API Documentation
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.title: Connect a Control Desk
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.text: Adjacent computers and wired modems automatically discover every loaded Aeroworks Control Desk as a peripheral.
guide.cc_aeroworks.start.note: Peripheral type: cc_aeroworks_control_desk. Desk sockets: left=0, right=1, big=2. API calls accept a name or index.
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.title: Inspect sockets and modules
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.text: getSockets returns the fixed left, right and big mapping. Module queries include socket and socketName plus ID, kind and value. getModule returns nil when empty.
guide.cc_aeroworks.modules.note: All socket methods accept for example "left" or 0. getModules returns occupied sockets only.
guide.cc_aeroworks.inputs.title: Read and monitor inputs
guide.cc_aeroworks.inputs.text: getInput reads a single axis or button. getInputs returns every readable module by socket. Changes are also emitted as events.
guide.cc_aeroworks.inputs.note: cc_aeroworks_desk_input supplies peripheral name, socket index, module ID, value, channel and finally socketName. Unchanged values emit no event.
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.title: Display text and numbers
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.text: Writing text, numbers and clearing all modify the same persistent display state. zeroPad adds leading zeroes.
guide.cc_aeroworks.displays.note: Two-digit displays store up to 2 characters, three-digit displays 3. Supported: 0-9, minus and space.
guide.cc_aeroworks.pixels.title: Draw displays pixel by pixel
guide.cc_aeroworks.pixels.text: Pixel coordinates start at 1,1 in the upper-left corner. Single pixels and complete grids switch the display to pixel mode.
guide.cc_aeroworks.pixels.note: Grid sizes: 7x5 for two-digit and 11x5 for three-digit. setDisplayPixels expects exactly five strings of 0 and 1.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.title: Combined mouse mode
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.text: Select Input Type Combined in the Aeroworks module screen and capture an activation key per axis in the centre field. Look at the module and hold that key.
guide.cc_aeroworks.controls.note: The camera remains still while a valid target is active. Releasing the key, opening a menu or losing the module ends the mode immediately.
guide.cc_aeroworks.example.title: Mirror an input to a display
guide.cc_aeroworks.example.text: This minimal program waits for desk input and writes each new value to the display in the named big socket.
